# RolegacyAI

RolegacyAI helps organizations preserve role memory, improve successor readiness, and reduce operational continuity risk when key people move on.

## Core positioning

RolegacyAI is focused on:
- role memory
- successor readiness
- operational continuity
- institutional knowledge preservation
- workflow intelligence
- capability transfer
- role skill packs
- AI uplift capture

RolegacyAI is not a generic AI chatbot, generic training platform, or AI note-taking tool.

## Key question

If your best employee left tomorrow, what would the next person inherit?

## Main use cases

- capturing role memory
- reducing tribal knowledge loss
- preparing successors
- improving onboarding
- preserving operational workflows
- transferring capability from experienced workers to future role holders
- capturing AI-assisted workflow improvements
